muc.title: Apps borrowing an AI brain
muc.text: Many apps have an AI button without making their own AI. They borrow another company's brain through an API.

muc.title: What an API is
muc.text: An API is a door that lets software talk to other software. The app sends a request through the door, and the AI sends the answer back.

muc.title: Paying per token
muc.text: Every call is charged by tokens, small pieces of text, which is why apps often limit free use.

muc.title: Where your words go
muc.text: What you type in the app may be sent to the AI company, so don't paste private information there.

muc.title: Read the privacy policy
muc.text: Open the privacy policy of an app with an AI button and find the line that says who it sends your data to.
